newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian ministry staff protest at Di Pietro going.
newsitem.headline: Italian ministry staff protest at Di Pietro going.

text.p: Hundreds of employees from Italy's public works ministry held an impromptu demonstration on Friday to try to persuade their former boss Antonio Di Pietro to return to the government.
Di Pietro quit unexpectedly as public works minister on Thursday after coming under investigation for alleged malpractice during his time as a graft-busting magistrate.
Police said up to 300 employees from the ministry demonstrated in front of their offices in central Rome.
"We are deeply saddened by Di Pietro's decision," one of the protesters was quoted as telling ANSA news agency. "We had hoped Di Pietro would finally straighten out this ministry."
Di Pietro, who belongs to no political party, became a people's hero after spearheading the vast graft probes that broke the corrupt mould of Italy's political old guard in the early 1990s.
